name: PR detail shows the Blast Radius card in a deterministically degraded state
description: Opens PR #482 (acme/payments-api) and checks the Blast Radius card on the default Overview tab (specs/blast-radius.md): the card title and the incomplete-index marker. The seed has no repo_index_state for acme/payments-api and clonePath: null, so the block is deterministically degraded regardless of the REPO_INTEL_ENABLED flag. Asserts only the incomplete-index title, not the reason text, since the reason is 'no_data' with the flag on and 'flag_off' with it off. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (run via ./scripts/e2e.sh).
